events.title: 🚴 Threshold A — 6×5' @ Z4 (Workout 1)
events.description:
From plans/2026-07-06.md

30' WU (trim to 20' if chasing daylight)
6 × 5' @ top of Z4 — 270-290W, HR → 168-180; 2' easy between
10-15' top of Z2 (195-210W) lactate clearance
Easy home, ~90 min total. Zwift OK.
End with a few left in the tank. Hit it → next time 7×5.

events.title: 🚴 Aerobic Z2 + 6×7s sprints
events.description:
From plans/2026-07-06.md

60' mostly Z2 (HR 122-153 / 155-210W)
6 × 6-8s sprints, ≥3' full spin between
Fog 12-17°C — sheltered route or Zwift. Recovery focus, workout tomorrow.

events.title: 🏃 VO2 A run — 4×3'/3' (Workout 2)
events.description:
From plans/2026-07-06.md

15' easy WU
4 × 3' hard (~3:55-4:05/km, best sustainable) / 3' easy jog
10-15' high Z2 (~5:10-5:20/km) — mandatory in VO2 A
Easy to ~55'. Before 1PM Dr appt.
Hit it → next time 5×3.

events.title: 🏃 Aerobic run Z1 + 4×20s strides
events.description:
From plans/2026-07-06.md

40-45' Z1/low Z2 (HR <145, ~5:45-6:15/km)
4 × 20s strides, 3' between
Truly easy — Thursday is a workout.

events.title: 🚴 VO2 B via Bike Club — 3×[6×30/30] (Workout 3)
events.description:
From plans/2026-07-06.md

Bike club ride IS the workout.
If mellow/solo: 15' WU, 3 × [6 × 30s hard ~310-330W / 30s easy], 5' easy between sets, 10-15' top Z2 after.
If spirited group ride: let the surges be the VO2 work — don't stack 30/30s on top.
Back for 5:30 Linear sync.

events.title: 🏋️ Strength — dumbbells (power) + optional yoga/spin
events.description:
From plans/2026-07-06.md

Hotel Lift power template:
Warmup circuit ×3 (stairclimbers, air squats, burpees, split jumps)
Box split jumps 3×5; seated box jumps ×3
SL DB RDL 3×8; pistol squats 3×8; SL calf raises 3×8
~50% 1RM, explosive, not to failure.
Optional 20-30' Z1 spin or yoga. Legs fresh for Saturday.

events.title: 🚴 Long ride — 3.5-4h, 60-75' high Z2 (key session)
events.description:

3.5-4h mostly Z1/Z2
60-75' block at high Z2 (195-210W) — progressing the high-Z2 time from Jul 3's 4h aerobic ride.
No workout inside — the week wasn't light.
14-22°C overcast, best day of the week.
